agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Independent verification still open.

expected_parent_change: The tree stops paying 5.43 bits to name a step in a language only the learner reads, and names the same element from the observation for 0.93 bits with ONE describable identity: 946 of 1415 actionable elements (66.9%) by a description alone, all 1415 with a description plus an ordinal that the observation already carries, and an ordinal stored with the peer-count it was taken under so a replay refuses instead of answering the wrong element.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The binding constraint moves off 'the learner needs more experience'. Experience lowers the price of a description already paid for and cannot lower the number a new task needs, so work is aimed at what the agent can express about a page, not at what it has done.

falsification_condition: A page on which the shared description, plus an ordinal validated against its stored peer-count, selects an element other than the one the recorded action names -- or a round trip that reports REFUTED for an element that is present and correctly described.
honest_limits: AUTHORITY NONE. Producer sandbox measurement only.
This deletes a second language; it does not add experience, weights, or capability.
The signature says which elements are indistinguishable, never which is correct.
